message.content: {"caption":"AgentEvolver workflow showing task generation, parallel trajectory rollout, experience summarization, and training-sample construction.","description":"A system architecture diagram organized around a Master at the top. Arrows connect it to a Task Manager, parallel Rollout Workers, an Experience Manager, and Sample Construction. The Task Manager interacts with an Environment Server; rollout workers use a Context Manager to exchange state and actions with the environment and an Async LLM Server, and retrieve experiences from the Experience Manager. Sample Construction sends training batches to Trainer Workers, which update model weights back at the Async LLM Server. The labeled flows indicate task assignment, exploration, experience retrieval and summarization, model updates, and training.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
